youtube_description:
₹0 free trial, just turn on UPI AutoPay… and a month later ₹499 is gone.

Free trials work because companies know many people forget to cancel. A 'subscription trap' is one of the 13 dark patterns in India's 2023 CCPA guidelines. Under RBI's e-mandate rules you must get an alert at least 24 hours before each auto-debit, and you can cancel a mandate anytime.

Rule: set a reminder the day you start a trial, and check the AutoPay section of your UPI app.

Sources: CCPA Dark Patterns Guidelines 2023; RBI e-mandate framework (Business Today, Apr 2026).
